readerCopy.body: A life built around avoiding an old hurt can start looking safer than the direction that would require a different response to it. When Chiron opposes the North Node, protection and forward movement pull against each other, making the familiar role, routine, or strategy especially convincing because it already knows how to reduce exposure. That protection may still matter. The question is what danger it is addressing now and what possibility it may also be keeping out.
